subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: Should rejected local avatars continue returning a generic direct `/avatar/{agentId}` 404 while safe reasons are shown through metadata/UI, or should the raw endpoint expose reason-specific failures such as 413 for oversized files?
rationale: The choice affects a local-file serving boundary and what validation details the authenticated raw endpoint may reveal, so it should not be inferred from the bug report alone.

options.title: Keep raw 404 and fix UI diagnostics
options.body: Use existing avatar metadata to show clear settings/chat diagnostics and avoid broken-image fallback without changing raw endpoint disclosure.

options.title: Expose selected raw 4xx reasons
options.body: Allow the direct endpoint to return specific safe failures such as oversized-file status after maintainers define the disclosure contract and tests.

options.title: Close as documented limit only
options.body: Treat the 2 MB limit and current settings diagnostics as sufficient, leaving chat broken-image behavior and raw 404 semantics unchanged.

recommendation.title: Keep raw 404 and fix UI diagnostics
recommendation.body: Use existing avatar metadata to show clear settings/chat diagnostics and avoid broken-image fallback without changing raw endpoint disclosure.

likelyOwner.reason: The avatar feature introduction and later avatar validation hardening both point to this owner for the local-file serving contract.
